asset01.note: Solid single-material part, so mass comes from steel density x volume. Mesh is already ~metric.

asset02.note: Mesh comes in at 4.3 m. Reconstructed walls are far thicker than 3 mm board, so mass is set directly and spread over the surface. The four top flaps hang folded outward.

asset03.note: Thin-walled; mass spread over the surface. Lid stands open at the back.

asset04.note: Euro container footprint 600 x 400 mm, ~2-3 mm walls. Mass from typical spec sheets.

asset05.note: Mesh is 0.70 m tall, real chairs are ~1.0-1.1 m. Seat swivels on the gas column; five casters swivel and roll. Seat assembly is mostly moulded plastic and steel, so polypropylene density stands in for it (fabric alone made the base the heaviest part).

asset06.note: Mesh holds two closed bodies: the low one is the aluminium piston, the tall one the steel rod. Total mass is set; the split follows density x volume.

asset07.note: Mesh comes in at 2.8 m. mass_kg is the empty bottle + trigger, spread over the surface; water fills the closed volume up to 45% of the height (from the photo).

asset08.note: Seat height ~45 cm. Solid wood, so mass is spread through the volume.

asset09.note: Mesh is already ~metric (0.77 m tall). Reconstructed legs are oversized, so mass is set directly.
